            mask=(s!=dom)&(s!=sep)

                st=[p]; cp=[]; seen.add(p)
                while st:
                    x,y=st.pop()
                    if (x,y) in cp: continue
                    cp.append((x,y))
                    for dx in(-1,0,1):
                        for dy in(-1,0,1):

                                seen.add((a,b)); st.append((a,b))
                comps.append(cp)
            sizes=[len(c) for c in comps]
            y_=int(Ok[bi,bj]==1)
            print(f"band{bi} col{bj}: shape={pic.shape} pixels={list(map(int,pic.flat))} sizes={sizes} out={y_}")

        if v==dom: continue
        rl=sum(map(bool,(Ik[i]==v for i in range(Ik.shape[0]))))  # any

        wl=sum(all(Ik[i,j]==v for j in range(Ik.shape[1])) for i in range(Ik.shape[0]))

    sep_rows=[i for i in range(Ik.shape[0]) if Ik[i].all()==sep]
